en: Ahhh...I'm so tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>I worked out for the first time in
a long while... I'm completely exhausted.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...it's a good kind of exhausted.
Alright, for now...sleep.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't have any intrusive thoughts that night.
As soon as my head hit the pillow...
<CLT=cltMIND>I fell into a deep, relaxing sleep.
<CLT=cltMIND>At the time, I didn't yet realize...

<CLT=cltMIND>Just how horrific it can be to
trust someone in this place...

What are you looking at?
Who...are you guys?

You're probably thinking, "This killing game is
taking forever. Someone just die already."

That is what you're thinking, right?
Man, you guys are messed up.

But I feel the same way, too.
Geez, why won't someone just die?

Watching people live and die is really the
best entertainment.

Some people say, "What do you think life
is?" Honestly, life is worthless.

When you die, you are quickly forgotten cuz
there's tons of replacements out there.

But if you die in a death game, everyone knows
who you are. That itself is a form of happiness.

Puhuhu... Who will find happiness next?
My heart's pounding with excitement.
...Rise and shine, ursine.

Nyum, nyum... This is an official announcement
from the Ultimate Academy...

Nom, nom... It is now 8 a.m.
Time to wake up...nyum, nyum...
What are you eating!?
...IT-IS-OKAY.
What's okay!?

IT-IS-NOW-8 A.M... EVERYBODY-WAKE-UP.
UNLESS-YOU-ARE-DEAD, THEN-DISREGARD.

LET-US-ALL-BE-POSITIVE-AND-EXCITED-
TODAY...
So long! Bear-well!
Ah... My body hurts...

<CLT=cltMIND>My muscles were still sore from
working out. But because of that...

I had a good night's sleep...
for the first time in a while.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps even the first full night's sleep since
I got here. So the soreness was nice, in a way.
...Alright. Breakfast.

<CLT=cltMIND>Eating a good breakfast became part
of my daily routine.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is it all the same uniform?
They could put casual clothes in here too...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND> is on here, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>We made a promise to not tell 
who has whose <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltMIND>.
